Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: The hand-back should defer only when the sweep is certain to re-run the attempt. `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` (`review_final_ci_failed_infra_verdict`, lines 72-98) already gets that decision from `ci_cancelled_rerun.py classify-run`, the same classifier the sweep uses. That classifier returns `abandoned` only for cancelled jobs with no timeout annotation (`shutdown_only_annotations`, `scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py` lines 195-200), so keying G4 on that verdict keeps the two automations in agreement. Option B breaks the issue's non-goal "Changing what `ci_cancelled_rerun.py` re-runs". Option C drops an explicit goal, while G1–G3 already stop the #9725 failure (a repair on a head that turned green) no matter how the attempt failed.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh (`review_final_ci_failed_infra_verdict`, the deferral block around lines 177-183, the log contract at line 57)
    - scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py (`INFRA_VERDICTS` line 147, `shutdown_only_annotations` lines 195-200, `classify_runner_shutdown` returning `abandoned` around line 535, `classify-run` CLI line 682)
    - tests/test_review_final_ci.py (existing hand-back tests to extend)
  steps:
    - Keep the deferral condition the existing classifier verdict on attempt 1 (`shutdown|action_resolution|checkout_fetch|abandoned`); do not change `classify-run` or what the sweep re-runs.
    - When the verdict is `abandoned` (only cancelled jobs, no timeout annotation, no failed test), also emit `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_FAILED pr=<n> head=<sha> outcome=deferred reason=cancelled_jobs_rerun`. Keep the existing `outcome=infra_rerun_deferred reason=abandoned` line and its tokens unchanged (§6, add alongside). Add `deferred` to the outcome list in the header log contract.
    - A job cancelled at its `timeout-minutes` limit carries a timeout annotation, so its verdict is `genuine` and it keeps today's hand-back. So do attempt >= 2, a classifier error or timeout, and switches set to off.
    - Use the jobs and annotation reads `classify-run` already makes. Add no new API call, job or workflow, and put all logic in `scripts/`, not in `ci.yml`.
    - Tests: attempt 1 with only abandoned (no-timeout) cancelled jobs logs `outcome=deferred reason=cancelled_jobs_rerun` and dispatches nothing. A timed-out job, a failed test job, attempt 2, or a classifier failure each hand back as today.
    - G1–G3 (the gate skip with `reason=final_ci_now_green`, and the repair step's re-check before the push) are unchanged and are what cover the timed-out #9725 case.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: G4's "only jobs that were cancelled or timed out" narrows to "only jobs the shared classifier reports as `abandoned` (cancelled without a timeout annotation)". Timed-out jobs hand back as today.
  equivalence_argument: G4 wants the two automations not to both act on one failed attempt. Deferring on exactly the verdict the sweep re-runs on means a deferral always has a matching re-run and a hand-back always means the sweep skips. When a timed-out attempt is handed back and later turns green some other way, G1–G3 stop the repair from replacing the green head.
  reversibility: If a human later wants timeouts deferred too, adding a timeout verdict to `classify-run` (option B) is purely additive. The new `deferred` log line can be removed without touching the existing `infra_rerun_deferred` contract.
